overview: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high fidelity desktop web application screen for webuddy, Chinese team hosted coding-agent workspace. A single horizontal 1536x1024 reference image, full readable app screen, no montage, no device frame. This is an operational product, not marketing. Refined calm editorial productivity design. Shared design system: 216px left sidebar ivory #f7f8f5; main canvas #f3f5f2; white surfaces; ink #20332f; muted #687872; teal #16786b, pale teal #e5f1eb; fine #dce3dd borders; 12px corners; spacious 32px main padding; Chinese sans-serif with 30px headings and 14-16px body. Sidebar brand webuddy, grouped navigation 工作区: 工作总览 项目 运行看板; 能力与经验: 能力模块 职能体 经验库; 团队管理: 调用记录 团队. Current page 工作总览. Main top heading 工作总览 with caption 把注意力留给重要的事. Top right action 新建项目. Below an airy horizontal start strip: 开始一项新工作, description 直接描述目标，也可以从已有项目继续, primary 新建项目, secondary 查看职能体. Below restrained 4 statistic columns 项目 3 / 进行中 1 / 待处理 0 / 成果已就绪 2 (illustrative data). Main section 当前工作, one wide project surface 专注计时器 with subtitle 持续推进，随时补充 and 查看进展 button. Inside project retain a six-stage horizontal progress board labelled 需求 方案 执行 验证 交付 沉淀; emphasize 执行 with pale teal fill and small ongoing dot, other stages light fine rules. Bottom section 最近成果 with two clean compact rows 工时测算工具 and 今日宜开心 and 查看成果 text links. No fake avatars, no decorative charts, no grand gradients, no huge hero, no nested card pile. Crisp hierarchy, ample breathing room, buildable CSS geometry. Only this single overview screen.
modules: Use case ui-mockup. One standalone horizontal 1536x1024 high fidelity webuddy Chinese desktop app screen: 能力模块. Refined operational productivity interface. Same shared system ivory #f7f8f5 sidebar 216px, main #f3f5f2, white surfaces, ink #20332f, teal #16786b and pale #e5f1eb, muted #687872, thin #dce3dd borders, 12px radii, 32px padding, readable Chinese sans 30px page title 14-16px text. Sidebar webuddy; groups 工作区: 工作总览 项目 运行看板; 能力与经验: 能力模块(selected) 职能体 经验库; 团队管理: 调用记录 团队. Header 能力模块 caption 把团队的知识与方法，变成随时可用的能力. Action 新建模块. Under header a clean pale green explanation band: 模块提供方法 · 职能体承接业务 with short copy 同一份能力，可以用于不同项目 and link 查看职能体. Main area two columns: 2/3 library with tabs 全部 界面风格 业务知识 工作方法 交付规范 and a searchbox 搜索模块. A 2-column four-card grid: 清爽产品界面(style); 浏览器验收(workflow); 交付说明(delivery); 团队业务知识(knowledge). Each simple card tiny outlined icon, category label, title, 2-line description, 查看内容 and contextual 编辑模块 text action, small v1 version in upper right. These are method documents NOT tool permission installs. Right 1/3 contextual guide titled 如何使用, three clearly spaced numbered rows 01 直接开始普通任务 / 无需先选择职能体; 02 按项目搭配能力 / 风格、知识和方法各取所需; 03 复用一类业务 / 从职能体入口持续维护. Bottom right restrained link 前往项目搭配. No fake enabled toggles, no install or agent-save button because this screen only edits modules and directs to existing project composition. Design beautiful through typography and whitespace, not decorative graphics, no avatar, no charts, no montage.
agents: Use case ui-mockup. Generate ONE standalone high fidelity horizontal 1536x1024 desktop webuddy application screenshot reference of 职能体工作台 default library view. Calm refined Chinese operational productivity design matching ivory #f7f8f5 216px left sidebar, #f3f5f2 main, white surfaces, #20332f ink, muted #687872, #16786b teal, pale #e5f1eb highlight, #dce3dd thin borders, 12px corners, 32px gutters, legible Chinese sans serif. Sidebar webuddy, groups 工作区: 工作总览 项目 运行看板; 能力与经验: 能力模块 职能体(selected) 经验库; 团队管理: 调用记录 团队. Main heading 职能体工作台 and subtitle 让反复出现的业务，有一个持续维护的入口. Primary top right 新建职能体. Intro pale teal horizontal band: 一类业务，一个长期伙伴. Supportcopy 上传资料、维护方法，再把任务交给它. Right text link 查看能力模块. Under it a 3-column library of believable agent cards with small monochrome outlined icons: 工时测算助手 / 用团队的计算规则处理工时资料; 旧项目维护助手 / 理解已有代码，持续修改与验证; 工业格式转换助手 / 按样例转换资料，检查输出. Each card has 业务用途 small kicker, version v1, clear bottom primary 开始任务 and secondary 维护方法. No made-up time saved, ratings, avatars, charts or toggles. These three entries are illustrative content. Below cards a generous horizontal quiet area '普通开发任务，直接开始就好' with caption '不需要先创建职能体；在项目中描述你的目标即可。' and outline button 前往项目. Avoid promising implemented automatic agent composition, save-combination buttons or tool installation. Avoid marketing hero, nested cards, excess decorative symbols. Single screen not collage. Focus beautiful spacing, realistic 14-16px text and 30px heading, clear action hierarchy.
